verdict.rationale: Drata has no documented data-export or offboarding feature. The only route out is its public API v2, whose List/Get endpoints cover controls, personnel, risks, audits, policies, policy versions, evidence library versions and monitoring tests. A user could pull much of their data programmatically, but only as a self-built workaround. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON archives of evidence files), offboarding/data-portability documentation, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that all data can be retrieved.
